name: stripe-bfcm-dashboard
cost: Free skill (MIT). It needs a Stripe account.
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build and other agents with the Stripe MCP server
short: Builds a Black Friday and Cyber Monday dashboard of your payments, customers and recurring revenue from your Stripe account.
what: This AI skill builds a fixed BFCM season dashboard from your connected Stripe account: recurring revenue, growth and payments for a time window, with an optional comparison. It runs a set list of read-only queries through the Stripe MCP server and makes a hosted dashboard where your agent supports one, or else a single HTML file. It is for the 2026 BFCM season only.
who: Stripe merchants who want their holiday numbers in one place without building reports. If you don't take payments through Stripe, skip it.
needs: The Stripe MCP server or connector, signed in to that account with access to the Analytics API and the Query Runs API (OAuth sign-in works best)

steps.title: Claude Code
steps.text: Stripe recommends its official plugin, which includes the skills. Run this in your project.

steps.title: Any other agent
steps.text: Manually installed skills don't auto-update. Run `npx skills update -y` to get the latest.

steps.title: Connect Stripe
steps.text: Connect the Stripe MCP server at https://mcp.stripe.com and sign in. Without it, the skill stops and tells you what to fix.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Ask: "build me a holiday dashboard" or "build me a Cyber Monday dashboard."

watch: It reads your live Stripe data through MCP. It is read-only, queries only counts and amounts, and never selects customer names or emails.
The build can take up to 10 minutes while the queries run.
A session signed in with an API key only sees that key's account and mode, and can't make a dashboard that refreshes itself.
It doesn't share the dashboard automatically. Check who can see it before you share it.
